image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) with distinct black and yellow patterning is positioned on a forest floor covered in dry leaves, moss, and small stones. The salamander's body is elongated and robust, displaying the characteristic glossy black skin with irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad with visible parotoid glands, and its short limbs are splayed against the ground. A long, laterally compressed tail extends behind it. In the lower right foreground, there is a semi-transparent green watermark or logo overlay containing text-like shapes.
